sla_onsite.text: onID="2.0.2">CRITERION.EXCLUSION.CONVICTIONS.PARTICIPATION_IN_CRIMINAL_ORGANISATION</cbc:CriterionTypeCode> <cbc:Name>Osalemine kuritegelikus organisatsioonis</cbc:Name> <cbc:Description languageID="ET">Kas ettevõtja ise või tema haldus-, juht- või järelevalveorgani liige või isik, kellel on volitused seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on lõpliku süüdimõistva kohtuotsusega süüdi mõistetud kuritegelikus organisatsioonis osalemise eest kõige rohkem viimase viie aasta jooksul või kehtib süüdimõistvas kohtuotsuses sätestatud kõrvalejäämise kohustus endiselt?</cbc:Description> <cac:Legislation> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">c753a2c5-59e6-4970-b6eb-27224e96bf76</cbc:ID> <cbc:Title languageID="ET">RHS § 95 lg 1 p 1 "keda või kelle haldus-, juhtimis- või järelevalveorgani liiget, prokuristi või muud isikut, kellel on volitus seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. certifications_partner.text: ===== FILE: files/191N6026Q0007-C-SCRM_Go-_No_Go_Evaluation_Factor_Template.docx ===== C-SCRM Go/No-Go Evaluation Factor Template (Aug 2026) C-SCRM Proposal/Quote Instructions (corresponding instructions to the factor below) Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM) Forms The offeror shall include in its offer Attachment 191N6026Q0007- C-SCRM Questionnaire. In lieu of a completed C-SCRM Questionnaire, the vendor may submit a third party authorizing official conducted assessment, such as International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27001, ISO 9000, System and Organizational Controls (SOC) II, or FedRAMP authorization. If the offeror is providing any critical software, the offeror must complete 191N6026Q0007- State Department Secure Software Development Attestation Form (or another agency’s equivalent form), and either include it in the offer or upload the form to a public website and provide a link to the form in the offer. Both documents must be completed in accordance with each attachment’s instructions. Failure to follow the attachment’s instructions may result in rejection of the offer. ip_data_security.text: the cost of services needed to operate and maintain NLS’s My Talking Books (an Amazon Alexa skill) in production. My Talking Books is an Amazon Alexa skill that enables NLS patrons to search the NLS collection, browse the NLS collection, retrieve/manage the patron’s Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Wishlist, stream NLS talking books, and manage the patron’s Bookshelf using a voice-only interface available on Alexa-enabled commercial smart-speaker platforms. The contractor shall be responsible for providing RealSAM Dialog licenses and services required to operate the system in production, while meeting all IT information-system security requirements as required by the Library of Congress. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. Thi

hall provide the Library with license and technical support. This support shall be provided on an annual basis at a firm-fixed price. This support shall be provided in blocks of 500. This support service must ensure that users with legacy RealSAM Dialog licenses can use the My Talking Books skill in production. The contractor shall provide the Library with a price schedule (Attachment J3 - Pricing Chart.xlsx) for the following scenarios: A. RealSAM Dialog License Support – An annual fee for blocks of 500 perpetual user licenses for the RealSAM dialog engine. This scenario reflects the current state of affairs where the contractor is hosting all required non-GFE services (Auth Proxy, Streaming Servers, Dialog Engine, etc.). B. RealSAM Dialog License Support with Auth Proxy hosted by the Library – same as scenario A, but the Library would host the Auth Proxy service instead of the contractor. C. RealSAM Legacy Dialog License Support with Auth Proxy and Streaming Servers hosted by the Library – same as scenario A, but the Library would host both the Auth Proxy service and Streaming Servers instead of the contractor. Kostnader ved utarbeidelse av tilbud Eventuelle kostnader leverandøren har ved utarbeidelse av tilbudet dekkes av leverandøren selv. Oppdragsgiver refunderer ikke kostnader knyttet til utarbeidelse eller innlevering av tilbud. Deltilbud Anskaffelsen er ikke delt i delkontrakter. Det er ikke adgang til deltilbud. Alternative tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere alternative tilbud. Side 4 av 11 Parallelle tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere parallelle tilbud. Hver leverandør kan ha ett gjeldende tilbud per delkontrakt. Forretningshemmeligheter og sladding Ved innlevering skal leverandøren ta stilling til om opplysninger i tilbudet utgjør forretningshemmeligheter, merke disse og levere en sladdet versjon der det er påkrevd. Oppdragsgiver behandler innsynsbegjæringer etter offentleglova og forvaltningsloven. Behandling av personopplysninger Personopplysninger som inngår i tilbudet behandles av oppdragsgiver for å gjennomføre anskaffelsen, evaluere tilbud og følge opp kontrakt. Behandlingen skjer i tråd med personvernregelverket. Leverandøren er ansvarlig for at personopplysninger i tilbudet er lovlig innhentet og nødvendige for tilbudet.
